FAQ

Printing Questions

Keep answers accurate and update them once the official service policies are confirmed.

What artwork files can I upload?

The interface accepts PDF, AI, EPS, SVG, PNG, JPG/JPEG, and PSD files. Confirm production compatibility with the team before final submission.

Can I request a custom size?

Yes, the configurator includes width and height fields for a custom specification. Final production capability should be confirmed with the team.

Can I order different materials?

The current configurator includes Vinyl, Paper, Mylar, Polystyrene, and an Other option. Only publish materials that the production team officially offers.

How does proof approval work?

A future proofing workflow can send a digital proof, record revisions, and capture final approval before production.

Do you offer rush orders?

The interface supports a rush-order concept, but rush availability and pricing should only be published after confirmation.

Can I reorder previous work?

Yes, a future business account can store previous specifications and artwork and provide a Quick Reorder function.

Can I get a custom quote?

Use the Custom Quote section for projects that require custom specifications or pricing review.

How do I track my order?

Once a real order-management system is connected, customers can follow order, proof, production, and shipping statuses.
